from scripts.aggregate import locate_spans, span_iou

# Test: 'neural network' appears twice in doc
doc = 'We use a neural network for classification. Another neural network handles generation.'

# Candidate 1: two mentions of 'neural network'
cand1 = [{'text': 'neural network', 'type': 'Method'}, {'text': 'neural network', 'type': 'Method'}]
locate_spans(doc, cand1)
print('Cand1 spans:')
for e in cand1:
    print(f'  text={e[\"text\"]!r} start={e[\"_start\"]} end={e[\"_end\"]} => {doc[e[\"_start\"]:e[\"_end\"]]!r}')

# Candidate 2: one mention at first position
cand2 = [{'text': 'neural network', 'type': 'Method'}]
locate_spans(doc, cand2)
print('Cand2 spans:')
for e in cand2:
    print(f'  text={e[\"text\"]!r} start={e[\"_start\"]} end={e[\"_end\"]} => {doc[e[\"_start\"]:e[\"_end\"]]!r}')

# Test IoU: cand1[0] vs cand2[0] should match (same position)
iou_00 = span_iou(cand1[0], cand2[0])
# cand1[1] vs cand2[0] should NOT match (different positions)
iou_10 = span_iou(cand1[1], cand2[0])
print(f'IoU(cand1[0], cand2[0]) = {iou_00:.3f}  (same pos, expect 1.0)')
print(f'IoU(cand1[1], cand2[0]) = {iou_10:.3f}  (diff pos, expect ~0)')

# Test: text not in doc (hallucination)
cand3 = [{'text': 'nonexistent entity', 'type': 'Method'}]
locate_spans(doc, cand3)
print(f'Hallucinated: start={cand3[0][\"_start\"]} end={cand3[0][\"_end\"]}')
"
